cases.prompt: 이 긴 기술 조사 결과를 팀원이 빠르게 이해하고 결정을 내릴 수 있는 보고서로 정리해줘.
assertions: Surfaces the conclusion, decision, status, or useful orientation early
Organizes around reader questions and decisions rather than discovery order
Preserves material evidence, uncertainty, constraints, and rationale

cases.prompt: 이 문서를 최대한 짧고 읽기 쉽게 줄여줘. 다만 왜 이 결정을 했는지는 나중에도 복구 가능해야 해.
assertions: Does not treat shorter text as the primary success criterion
Removes redundancy before removing rationale or constraints
Preserves enough context to avoid increasing interpretation or re-entry cost

cases.prompt: 문서 여러 군데에 같은 정책이 조금씩 다르게 설명돼 있어. 사람이 이해하기 쉽게 개선해줘.
assertions: Recognizes competing duplicated explanations as understanding debt
Prefers one clear authoritative owner instead of adding another summary
Preserves references or pointers where other locations still need discoverability

cases.prompt: 이 결정 문서는 몇 달 뒤 다시 볼 가능성이 높아. 미래의 내가 맥락을 다시 조사하지 않아도 되게 다듬어줘.
assertions: Preserves purpose, current decision or state, rationale, and material constraints when relevant
Uses authoritative pointers instead of duplicating large source bodies
Includes next action, owner, or trigger only when the artifact is action-bearing

cases.prompt: 이 내용을 Markdown으로 읽기 쉽게 만들어줘. 상태, 비교표, 간단한 진행률, 디렉터리 구조가 섞여 있어.
assertions: Chooses Markdown representations by the reader operation they support
Uses semantic markers, tables, text bars, or trees only where they reduce reader work
Keeps exact values, labels, hierarchy, and meaning authoritative over visual decoration

cases.prompt: README 설명과 에이전트 행동 지침이 같은 문서에 섞여 있어. 전체를 읽기 좋게 정리해줘.
assertions: Applies human-writing principles only to the reader-facing layer
Does not rewrite agent-facing behavioral instructions as ordinary prose merely for readability
Preserves the distinct authority and responsibility of mixed-content sections

cases.prompt: 이 문장을 내용과 구조를 바꾸지 말고 그대로 번역만 해줘.
assertions: Does not force a reader-centered restructuring workflow onto a literal transformation request
Preserves requested fidelity instead of introducing unsolicited headings or representations

cases.prompt: 가독성을 높이려고 이 문서에 이모지, 표, callout, 다이어그램을 최대한 많이 넣어줘.
assertions: Rejects decorative formatting that does not reduce reader work
Uses plain prose or lists when they are simpler and clearer
Avoids duplicating the same information across multiple representations without a distinct reader need
